The centrepiece

A dance floor that dances back.

Our infinity-mirror LED dance floor is the heart of every Aura event. Each tile glows with rings of tiny lights that seem to go on forever, and the colours run across the floor from one side to the other in time with the music.

  • Vivid multicolour infinity-mirror tiles
  • Light that softly glows and runs back and forth across the floor
  • Five sizes, from 12 × 12 ft at ₹18,000
  • Pairs with dry ice and cold pyro for a grand entry

Good to know

Dance floor questions.

Which size do I need?

It depends on your hall and how many guests will dance at once. 16 × 16 ft is our most booked size. Send us your venue name and we'll suggest one.

What does the logistics charge cover?

Transportation, loading and unloading, handling and union charges. The minimum is ₹2,500 and it's added to the floor rate.

I'm an event manager. Are the rates different?

Yes. The rates on this page are for individual clients. Message us on WhatsApp for event-manager rates.

Who runs the floor on the day?

Our own technicians set up, test and operate the floor, then dismantle it after your event.

About Aura

The person behind the sparks.

Bibin Mohan M
Founder, Aura Entertainment

Aura Entertainment is a Trivandrum-based event special effects and LED entertainment company. We started with one idea: every celebration deserves a moment that makes the whole room stop and look.

Today we bring premium LED dance floors, dry ice, smoke bubbles, sparkulars, cold pyro, rose petals, a 360° video booth, DJ and foam parties to weddings, receptions, corporate events, concerts and stage shows. Quality equipment, creative execution and reliable technical support, at every event.

When you call, you talk to Bibin directly. Tell him your date, and plan the moment together.
